tasks.subject: 生物
tasks.title: 细胞分工与表达组合
teaching_purpose: 用具体结构解释不同细胞的任务
区分细胞增殖与分化并说明协作意义
scientific_relations: 同源细胞可有不同表达组合
数量和类型两个轴分开
每种结构配具体功能箭头
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Distinguish an increase in cell number from differentiation into new types. Connect each specific cellular structure to a mechanism and then its function.
formulas_units_variables: 增殖主要改变数量；分化形成不同特征和功能类型，两者可在发育中相伴但不等同。
多数有核体细胞遗传信息大体相同，表达组合可不同。
结构→具体物理/生化作用→功能结果，比只写“结构适应功能”更完整。
tasks.composition: 2–3逻辑面板；主结构左/上，条件与验算右/下；不以颜色独占编码
tasks.prompt_zh: 制作生物第4章《细胞分化》4.1《细胞的分工》的教学图《细胞分工与表达组合》。教学目标：用具体结构解释不同细胞的任务；区分细胞增殖与分化并说明协作意义。必须对象：具体细胞类型；结构与功能对应；来源或表达关系箭头；模型限制与对照。不可画错的关系：同源细胞可有不同表达组合；数量和类型两个轴分开；每种结构配具体功能箭头。中文标签：增殖；分化；肌肉细胞；神经细胞；吸收细胞。公式、单位和条件：增殖主要改变数量；分化形成不同特征和功能类型，两者可在发育中相伴但不等同。；多数有核体细胞遗传信息大体相同，表达组合可不同。；结构→具体物理/生化作用→功能结果，比只写“结构适应功能”更完整。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter4, authentic subsection4.1, with original Chinese title 细胞的分工. Topic-specific mandatory science: Distinguish an increase in cell number from differentiation into new types. Connect each specific cellular structure to a mechanism and then its function. Make an accurate cell-differentiation teaching schematic. Distinguish cell proliferation, differentiation, specialization and organism-level cloning. Most nucleated somatic cells share much genomic information but express different subsets. Show mature mammalian erythrocytes without a nucleus or mitochondria, and do not generalize that structure to every species. Stem-cell potency is a conditional range, not guaranteed unlimited repair. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 具体细胞类型；结构与功能对应；来源或表达关系箭头；模型限制与对照. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: 增殖；分化；肌肉细胞；神经细胞；吸收细胞. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: 增殖主要改变数量；分化形成不同特征和功能类型，两者可在发育中相伴但不等同。；多数有核体细胞遗传信息大体相同，表达组合可不同。；结构→具体物理/生化作用→功能结果，比只写“结构适应功能”更完整。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.
tasks.negative_prompt: No incorrect arrow directions, reversed DNA polarity, unbalanced chemical charges, omitted denominator exclusions, Celsius in absolute-temperature powers, invented data, fake official scoring, impossible cell structures, decorative curves replacing equations, duplicate labels, tiny low-contrast text, clipping, watermark or photorealism replacing a scientific schematic.
acceptance_criteria: 同源细胞可有不同表达组合
数量和类型两个轴分开
每种结构配具体功能箭头
逐项核对对象、中文、数值、单位与定义域/模型条件
图示与原例题条件一致，不机械套用其他题的数据
检查320/390px与桌面缩放及放大，无文字裁切
XML/路径通过不代表科学审核通过，发布前需单独复核

tasks.title: 细胞更新与组织功能恢复
teaching_purpose: 区分细胞更新、组织修复与完整再生
由来源和功能证据评价再生结论
scientific_relations: 数量恢复与功能恢复分开
瘢痕修复不自动等同完整再生
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Cell-number recovery, wound closure and restoration of original tissue function are different outcomes. Trace source, identity, structure and function separately.
formulas_units_variables: 细胞数恢复≠原组织结构与功能全部恢复。
再生需来源、分裂/分化、合适环境与组织连接等条件。
评价指标可分数量、身份、结构、功能和长期稳定性，不只看伤口闭合。

tasks.title: 克隆的层级与信息来源
teaching_purpose: 区分细胞克隆与个体克隆
用核移植证据解释遗传信息保留而不夸大同一性
scientific_relations: 单细胞群增殖不等于完整个体
核供体与细胞质提供者分开
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Separate cell cloning from whole-organism cloning. Nuclear donor, cytoplasmic donor and developmental environment contribute differently; mitochondrial inheritance must not be omitted.
formulas_units_variables: 细胞克隆=相应单来源细胞的后代群；个体克隆需完成更高层级发育。
核移植结果可支持分化核保留广泛信息，但成功有条件。

负荷或排出率=相应液体浓度×体积流率；单位先统一。
同一物质的滤过与重吸收可同时很大，最终排出接近0不代表从未滤过。

tasks.title: 等质量固体的面积效应
teaching_purpose: 用碰撞与键结构解释本性差异
设计只改变固体暴露面积的对照
scientific_relations: 2 cm立方体切8块后面积倍增但体积不变
等物质的量完整反应平台相同
粉末模型初始斜率较大
tasks.scientific_relations_en: A2cm cube cut into eight1cm cubes keeps volume8cm cubed but doubles total area from24 to48cm squared. Equal reacted amounts can share the same gas plateau.
formulas_units_variables: 同密度同质量固体分成n个相似小块时，总体积不变、总面积增加。
边长L的立方体切为8个L/2立方体：面积从6L²增至8×6(L/2)²=12L²。
暴露面积改变速率；完整反应的最终量仍由限量物质决定。

tasks.prompt_zh: 制作化学第20章《化学反应速率》20.2.1《反应物的本性和表面积大小与化学反应速率》的教学图《等质量固体的面积效应》。教学目标：用碰撞与键结构解释本性差异；设计只改变固体暴露面积的对照。必须对象：对照实验条件；随时间记录的数据；粒子或能量示意；单位与适用条件。不可画错的关系：2 cm立方体切8块后面积倍增但体积不变；等物质的量完整反应平台相同；粉末模型初始斜率较大。中文标签：24 cm²；48 cm²；同质量；同温同浓度；CO₂体积。公式、单位和条件：同密度同质量固体分成n个相似小块时，总体积不变、总面积增加。；边长L的立方体切为8个L/2立方体：面积从6L²增至8×6(L/2)²=12L²。；暴露面积改变速率；完整反应的最终量仍由限量物质决定。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。

State controlled variables and measure initial slopes consistently. A catalyst changes the pathway activation barrier, not the overall reaction enthalpy or equilibrium constant. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: 同密度同质量固体分成n个相似小块时，总体积不变、总面积增加。；边长L的立方体切为8个L/2立方体：面积从6L²增至8×6(L/2)²=12L²。；暴露面积改变速率；完整反应的最终量仍由限量物质决定。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter6, authentic subsection6.2, with original Chinese title 一元二次不等式. Topic-specific mandatory science: Compare upward-opening quadratics with two distinct real roots, a repeated root and no real roots. A repeated root does not reverse the sign. Create an exact mathematical inequality diagram. Construct all lines, endpoints, signs and feasible regions deterministically. Distinguish excluded denominator roots from included numerator roots. Use open and closed endpoints consistently. Label Chinese text exactly as specified. Never approximate or invent a feasible boundary. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 数轴或直角坐标系；边界与禁点；分区符号或可行区域；推导条件框. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: a>0；Δ>0；Δ=0；Δ<0；r₁；r₂. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: a≠0，Δ=b²−4ac；若两异根为r₁<r₂，则原式=a(x−r₁)(x−r₂)。；a>0且Δ>0时，原式≤0的解为[r₁,r₂]。；a>0的二次式恒正⇔Δ<0；恒非负⇔Δ≤0。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.
tasks.negative_prompt: No incorrect arrow directions, reversed DNA polarity, unbalanced chemical charges, omitted denominator exclusions, Celsius in absolute-temperature powers, invented data, fake official scoring, impossible cell structures, decorative curves replacing equations, duplicate labels, tiny low-contrast text, clipping, watermark or photorealism replacing a scientific schematic.

tasks.subject: 数学
tasks.title: 平方差与均值不等式
teaching_purpose: 选择作差、平方或均值关系并核条件
检查等号可达性后求最值
tasks.scientific_relations_en: For nonnegative a,b with a+b=10, ab is at most25 and equality requires a=b=5. On x>0, x+9/x is at least6 with equality only at x=3; excluding3 removes attainment without removing the lower bound.
formulas_units_variables: a²+b²−2ab=(a−b)²≥0，等号a=b。
a,b≥0⇒(a+b)/2≥√(ab)；不可省略符号条件。
x>0,c>0⇒x+c/x≥2√c，等号x=√c，仍须核额外限制。
tasks.composition: 2–3逻辑面板；主结构左/上，条件与验算右/下；不以颜色独占编码
tasks.prompt_zh: 制作数学第31章《数学方法》31.2《不等式的证明》的教学图《平方差与均值不等式》。教学目标：选择作差、平方或均值关系并核条件；检查等号可达性后求最值。必须对象：平方差(a−b)²；固定和矩形；x+9/x曲线；等号点。不可画错的关系：ab≤25在a+b10时于5,5取等；x+9/x仅画x>0分支；最小点(3,6)。中文标签：a=b；x>0；(3,6)；等号条件。公式、单位和条件：a²+b²−2ab=(a−b)²≥0，等号a=b。；a,b≥0⇒(a+b)/2≥√(ab)；不可省略符号条件。；x>0,c>0⇒x+c/x≥2√c，等号x=√c，仍须核额外限制。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter31, authentic subsection31.2, with original Chinese title 不等式的证明. Topic-specific mandatory science: For nonnegative a,b with a+b=10, ab is at most25 and equality requires a=b=5. On x>0, x+9/x is at least6 with equality only at x=3; excluding3 removes attainment without removing the lower bound. Make a precise mathematical proof or numerical-method diagram. Quantifiers, base case, implication direction, equality conditions and domain restrictions must be explicit. Numerical approximations must not be labeled exact; plot tangents from the correct points. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 平方差(a−b)²；固定和矩形；x+9/x曲线；等号点. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: a=b；x>0；(3,6)；等号条件. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: a²+b²−2ab=(a−b)²≥0，等号a=b。；a,b≥0⇒(a+b)/2≥√(ab)；不可省略符号条件。；x>0,c>0⇒x+c/x≥2√c，等号x=√c，仍须核额外限制。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.
tasks.negative_prompt: No incorrect arrow directions, reversed DNA polarity, unbalanced chemical charges, omitted denominator exclusions, Celsius in absolute-temperature powers, invented data, fake official scoring, impossible cell structures, decorative curves replacing equations, duplicate labels, tiny low-contrast text, clipping, watermark or photorealism replacing a scientific schematic.
acceptance_criteria: ab≤25在a+b10时于5,5取等
x+9/x仅画x>0分支
逐项核对对象、中文、数值、单位与定义域/模型条件
图示与原例题条件一致，不机械套用其他题的数据
检查320/390px与桌面缩放及放大，无文字裁切
XML/路径通过不代表科学审核通过，发布前需单独复核

tasks.subject: 数学
tasks.title: 反证与量词的逻辑流程
teaching_purpose: 准确否定结论并从假设推出矛盾
区分反证、逆否及反例的用途
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Contradiction retains the premises and temporarily negates the precise conclusion. Negating a universal statement gives an existential counterexample. Proving at most one root does not prove existence. The product of listed primes plus1 need not itself be prime.
formulas_units_variables: 反证P⇒Q：保留P并暂设非Q，推得与已知事实冲突。
唯一性需至多一个与至少一个；两者证明责任不同。
tasks.composition: 2–3逻辑面板；主结构左/上，条件与验算右/下；不以颜色独占编码
tasks.prompt_zh: 制作数学第31章《数学方法》31.3《反证法》的教学图《反证与量词的逻辑流程》。教学目标：准确否定结论并从假设推出矛盾；区分反证、逆否及反例的用途。必须对象：条件P；临时非Q；推理链；矛盾标记；Q结论。不可画错的关系：P与非Q同时假设；矛盾指向已知事实；唯一性另需存在。中文标签：∀与∃；互质；0<0不可能；至多一个。公式、单位和条件：反证P⇒Q：保留P并暂设非Q，推得与已知事实冲突。；非“∀x A(x)”=“∃x 非A(x)”；非“a>b”=“a≤b”。；唯一性需至多一个与至少一个；两者证明责任不同。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。

Topic-specific mandatory science: Contradiction retains the premises and temporarily negates the precise conclusion. Negating a universal statement gives an existential counterexample. Proving at most one root does not prove existence. The product of listed primes plus1 need not itself be prime. Make a precise mathematical proof or numerical-method diagram. Quantifiers, base case, implication direction, equality conditions and domain restrictions must be explicit. Numerical approximations must not be labeled exact; plot tangents from the correct points. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 条件P；临时非Q；推理链；矛盾标记；Q结论. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: ∀与∃；互质；0<0不可能；至多一个. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: 反证P⇒Q：保留P并暂设非Q，推得与已知事实冲突。；非“∀x A(x)”=“∃x 非A(x)”；非“a>b”=“a≤b”。；唯一性需至多一个与至少一个；两者证明责任不同。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.

tasks.title: 二分区间与Newton切线
teaching_purpose: 实施二分与Newton迭代并保留有效条件

tasks.scientific_relations_en: Newton tangents for f=x squared-5 start at(2,-1), meet the x axis at2.25, and next produce161/72. Bisection needs continuity plus opposite signs. After n interval halvings, midpoint error is at most initial width divided by2 to the power(n+1).

Newton：x_(n+1)=x_n−f(x_n)/f′(x_n)，须核分母、定义域和收敛行为。

Topic-specific mandatory science: Six same-side peaks define five cycles. A full one-dimensional cycle has path4A but zero displacement, and peak-to-peak is2A. Equal position with opposite velocity is not the same phase. Use deterministic oscillator plots. Label equilibrium and positive direction. Restoring force and acceleration oppose displacement, not necessarily velocity. Distinguish time graphs from spatial wave snapshots, displacement amplitude from peak-to-peak, and damped resonance from an ideal unlimited model. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 平衡点；±A端点；同侧六峰；五时间间隔；路程条. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: A；2A；4A；T；f=1/T. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: 稳定周期运动f=1/T，ω=2πf。；一维对称往复峰峰值2A，一周期路程4A、位移0。；从第1同侧峰到第N同侧峰共有N−1个完整周期。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.

tasks.prompt_zh: 制作物理第13章《温度与热量》13.6《液体的热膨胀》的教学图《液体、容器与表观液面》。教学目标：用体膨胀解释液面与密度变化；区分液体真实膨胀与容器中的表观膨胀。必须对象：测量对象或受热物；温标/能量或体积轴；已知数值；条件与误差框。不可画错的关系：液体增20mL容器增0.60mL故溢19.4mL；质量保持时体积增密度降；柱高需结合管截面。中文标签：β液；β容；真实膨胀；表观膨胀；ΔV=AΔh；水异常温区。公式、单位和条件：小变化真实体积膨胀ΔV≈β_液V₀ΔT。；相同初始容量及温差下表观溢出≈(β_液−β_容)V₀ΔT，需满容器且无损失等条件。；固定质量ρ=ρ₀/(1+βΔT)；细管体积变化ΔV=A管Δh。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。

scientific_relations: 热流体由底部上升、冷流体侧面回流
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Natural convection requires the stated density, gravity and geometry conditions. Forced convection is driven by a fan or pump. Heat itself is not a material that always rises.
formulas_units_variables: 自然对流：温度变化→密度差→重力场中的浮力不平衡→宏观循环。
强迫对流由泵或风扇驱动，不要求完全依赖自然浮升。
若题设给定换热系数h，可用P=hAΔT，h单位W·m⁻²·K⁻¹。

tasks.prompt_zh: 制作物理第14章《热的传递》14.3《热对流》的教学图《自然与强迫对流》。教学目标：以密度、浮力和重力解释自然对流；区分自然与强迫对流并设计对照。必须对象：透明容器；底部热源；上下流动箭头；顶部加热对照；风扇。不可画错的关系：热流体由底部上升、冷流体侧面回流；顶部加热对流较弱；风扇驱动强迫流。中文标签：较热低密度；较冷高密度；自然对流；强迫对流。公式、单位和条件：自然对流：温度变化→密度差→重力场中的浮力不平衡→宏观循环。；强迫对流由泵或风扇驱动，不要求完全依赖自然浮升。；若题设给定换热系数h，可用P=hAΔT，h单位W·m⁻²·K⁻¹。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter14, authentic subsection14.3, with original Chinese title 热对流. Topic-specific mandatory science: Natural convection requires the stated density, gravity and geometry conditions. Forced convection is driven by a fan or pump. Heat itself is not a material that always rises. Make a deterministic thermal-transfer teaching diagram. Energy-transfer arrows point from higher to lower temperature for spontaneous net transfer. Distinguish microscopic energy transfer from bulk mass motion. Quantitative conduction diagrams must label area perpendicular to heat flow and thickness along it. Radiation formulas use absolute temperature in kelvin and explicitly stated emissivity and surroundings. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 透明容器；底部热源；上下流动箭头；顶部加热对照；风扇. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: 较热低密度；较冷高密度；自然对流；强迫对流. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: 自然对流：温度变化→密度差→重力场中的浮力不平衡→宏观循环。；强迫对流由泵或风扇驱动，不要求完全依赖自然浮升。；若题设给定换热系数h，可用P=hAΔT，h单位W·m⁻²·K⁻¹。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.
tasks.negative_prompt: No incorrect arrow directions, reversed DNA polarity, unbalanced chemical charges, omitted denominator exclusions, Celsius in absolute-temperature powers, invented data, fake official scoring, impossible cell structures, decorative curves replacing equations, duplicate labels, tiny low-contrast text, clipping, watermark or photorealism replacing a scientific schematic.
acceptance_criteria: 热流体由底部上升、冷流体侧面回流
顶部加热对流较弱
风扇驱动强迫流

图示与原例题条件一致，不机械套用其他题的数据

tasks.title: 气体状态表与压力参考
teaching_purpose: 定义平衡状态P、V、T及气体量
区分绝对压与表压并统一温度和体积单位
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Label equilibrium P,V,T and gas amount independently. Absolute pressure equals ambient plus signed gauge pressure. Convert liters to cubic meters and Celsius to kelvin before ratios. Sealed is not necessarily rigid; a rigid open vessel can change amount.
formulas_units_variables: P_abs=P_atm+P_gauge，按代数符号使用，气体式不用未换算表压。
密闭、刚性、恒温分别约束不同量，不能互相代替。
tasks.composition: 2–3逻辑面板；主结构左/上，条件与验算右/下；不以颜色独占编码
tasks.prompt_zh: 制作物理第15章《气体定律》15.1《气体的状态参量》的教学图《气体状态表与压力参考》。教学目标：定义平衡状态P、V、T及气体量；区分绝对压与表压并统一温度和体积单位。必须对象：封闭活塞；刚性开阀容器；真空零点；大气线；状态表。不可画错的关系：密闭固定量不必固定V；开阀刚性可变n；绝对压从真空计。中文标签：P_abs；P_gauge；V/m³；T/K；n/mol。公式、单位和条件：P_abs=P_atm+P_gauge，按代数符号使用，气体式不用未换算表压。；T/K=t/℃+273.15；1 L=10⁻³m³，1cm³=10⁻⁶m³。；密闭、刚性、恒温分别约束不同量，不能互相代替。。采用2至3个逻辑面板，主关系在左/上，条件与验算在右/下。建议1280×960、4:3，最小标签24px，四周留48px，不靠颜色单独区分。图形须SVG或数学绘图库确定性构造；AI只可作构图草稿，科学校验通过前不得教学发布。图中数据是原创教学示例，不是实测或官方考题。手机缩放和放大应可读，文字不裁切。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter15, authentic subsection15.1, with original Chinese title 气体的状态参量. Topic-specific mandatory science: Label equilibrium P,V,T and gas amount independently. Absolute pressure equals ambient plus signed gauge pressure. Convert liters to cubic meters and Celsius to kelvin before ratios. Sealed is not necessarily rigid; a rigid open vessel can change amount. Use deterministic gas-law plots and piston schematics. Explicitly label which of amount, pressure, volume and temperature is fixed. All ratios use absolute pressure and kelvin temperature. Particle sizes remain unchanged in simple expansion pictures; do not imply the molecular material volume equals the vessel volume. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 封闭活塞；刚性开阀容器；真空零点；大气线；状态表. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: P_abs；P_gauge；V/m³；T/K；n/mol. Typeset and verify these reference formulas, units and stated conditions: P_abs=P_atm+P_gauge，按代数符号使用，气体式不用未换算表压。；T/K=t/℃+273.15；1 L=10⁻³m³，1cm³=10⁻⁶m³。；密闭、刚性、恒温分别约束不同量，不能互相代替。. Use two or three separated panels, main relationship on the left or top and conditions/checks on the right or bottom. Size1280x960,ratio4:3,minimum label24px,safe margin48px. Use SVG or a deterministic plotting library for scientific geometry, structure, arrows and numbers. AI output may only be a draft layout and cannot be published before scientific review. Values are illustrative teaching data, not measurements or official examination figures. Ensure mobile scaling, zoom readability and no clipped labels.
tasks.negative_prompt: No incorrect arrow directions, reversed DNA polarity, unbalanced chemical charges, omitted denominator exclusions, Celsius in absolute-temperature powers, invented data, fake official scoring, impossible cell structures, decorative curves replacing equations, duplicate labels, tiny low-contrast text, clipping, watermark or photorealism replacing a scientific schematic.

tasks.title: 理想气体的两种计量
teaching_purpose: 在统一单位下应用PV=nRT及粒子形式
解释模型条件及固定量时综合关系
tasks.scientific_relations_en: Match mole amount n with R and particle count N with Boltzmann constant k. PV=nRT=NkT, N=nNA. SI pressure-volume is joules. The equation of state does not determine process heat or work and is only an approximation for real gases.
formulas_units_variables: PV=nRT=Nk_BT，N=nN_A，R=N_Ak_B。
固定n：P₁V₁/T₁=P₂V₂/T₂；变n：PV/(nT)=R。

tasks.prompt_en: Create a standalone UEC senior-high teaching diagram for chapter15, authentic subsection15.5, with original Chinese title 气体的等容变化 压强定律. Topic-specific mandatory science: At fixed amount and volume absolute pressure is proportional to kelvin temperature. A Celsius plot is shifted. Real-gas low-temperature condensation can invalidate the extrapolation. Heating changes particle motion rather than scaling particle radii. Use deterministic gas-law plots and piston schematics. Explicitly label which of amount, pressure, volume and temperature is fixed. All ratios use absolute pressure and kelvin temperature. Particle sizes remain unchanged in simple expansion pictures; do not imply the molecular material volume equals the vessel volume. Required objects, preserving these Chinese labels: 密闭刚室；速度箭头；P-T/K直线；P-t/℃平移图；相变限制注. Additional literal Chinese annotation strings: n,V固定；P_abs；T/K；理想外推. tasks.title: 棱镜透射与最小偏向
teaching_purpose: 以折射定律和棱镜几何求偏向

tasks.scientific_relations_en: Prism internal angles satisfy r1+r2=A and deviation delta=i+e-A. Minimum deviation is a special symmetric transmitted path. Stationary-interface ordinary refraction preserves frequency, while speed and wavelength change. Normal visible dispersion bends violet more than red in the stated glass.
formulas_units_variables: r₁+r₂=A；δ=i+e−A，角i,r,e均相对对应法线。
最小偏向透射：i=e，r₁=r₂=A/2，n=sin[(A+δ_min)/2]/sin(A/2)。

tasks.scientific_relations_en: Separate continuum, emission-line and absorption-line arrangements. Absorption needs the appropriate background and gas path. Photon energy is hf=hc/lambda, not proportional to wavelength. Unspecified lines are teaching schematics, not invented measured element spectra.
formulas_units_variables: 真空中f=c/λ，光子能量E=hf=hc/λ；波长短不代表能量低。
发射线：向低能态跃迁发光；吸收线需背景及相应吸收气体等条件。

tasks.title: 光学模型的证据与范围
teaching_purpose: 将模型主张与可检验现象对应

scientific_relations: 几何极限可由波动近似

tasks.scientific_relations_en: Connect each optical model with evidence and its domain. Geometric straight-line propagation can be a short-wavelength limit of waves, so a sharp shadow alone does not uniquely prove classical corpuscles. Dark interference regions represent redistribution, not destruction of total energy.
formulas_units_variables: 几何光学常在λ远小于相关结构尺度时适用，并不排除波动本性。
相干光场叠加需先加振幅及相位，再求强度，不能无条件只加亮度。
